1.Title: Bird Hunter
1.Description: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
1.Lore: While Nekomata lacks strength due to her small size, she has the perceptiveness and agility required to locate her enemies' weaknesses and strike right where it hurts most.

2.Title: Cat & Mouse
2.Description: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.
2.Lore:
Cats always prefer to toy with their prey.
If there's only one mouse left in combat — that's Nekomata's play time.

3.Title: Curious Left Tail
3.Lore:
According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within...
Even if that's not true, the experience Nekomata has gained on the streets certainly is.

4.Title: Sharpen Claws
4.Description: When Nekomata uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.
4.Lore:
"Gimme more, gimme MORE! I can eat 'em all~"
Her eyes sparkle as she licks the back of her paws.

5.Title: Lucky Right Tail
5.Lore: According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within... Sometimes Nekomata wonders to herself: If she is lucky enough to keep surviving, will she eventually grow another tail?

6.Title: Predator Lineage
6.Description: When Nekomata launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
6.Lore:
"When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior,
their latent animalistic tendencies emerge.
Fortunately, these tendencies aren't permanent..."
—Excerpt from the Handbook of Incomplete Research on Feline Thirens

DescriptionByLevel.1:
When Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> hits an enemy, her DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Nekomata gains 40 <Term:1000024></Term> upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Nekomata is in combat, she gains 1 Purr Energy every second, up to a maximum of 60. Different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy when they hit an enemy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail. Then press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to perform Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw once without consuming Purr Energy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 40 Purr Energy and activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.
When using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw, Nekomata enters the <Term:1000025></Term> state for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, Nekomata's attacks trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing an additional instance of <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 30% of her ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Nekomata restores 20 additional Purr Energy when using her Ultimate, 10 when using her Chain Attack, and 5 when using her EX Special Attack.

MathSkill.Title: Additional Ability: Catwalk
MathSkill.Description:
When another character in your squad is a Support character, or shares the same attribute or Faction:
After Nekomata uses <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Disappearing Tail</color>, or after any squad member inflicts <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> on an enemy, Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> deal 35% more DMG on hit. This effect stacks up to 2 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

AwakenAbility.Title: Awakened Potential: Nightborne Instinct
AwakenAbility.Description: While Nekomata is in the Pawpad Ambush state, her CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.

1000024.Title: Purr Energy
1000024.Description:
Nekomata gains 40 Purr Energy upon entering the battlefield. She recovers 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Purr Energy</color> every second, and different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy on hit.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 40 Purr Energy and directly activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.

1000025.Title: Pawpad Ambush
1000025.Description:
Nekomata enters Pawpad Ambush state for 40s after using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind and trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 30% of Nekomata's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.

102100002.Title: Basic Attack: Kitty Slash
102100002.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to five slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When the final slash lands on a Stunned enemy, it repeats three additional times.

102100004.Title: Basic Attack: Crimson Blade
102100004.Description:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the first three hits of Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front and passes through them, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If this skill hits a Stunned enemy, it repeats three additional times.

102100006.Title: Special Attack: Surprise Attack
102100006.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
This skill's pursuit effect is enhanced.

102100008.Title: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!
102100008.Description:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
This skill's pursuit effect is enhanced.

102110018.Title: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!

102100009.Title: Dodge: Can't Touch Me-ow~
102100009.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

102100010.Title: Dodge: Disappearing Tail
102100010.Description:
With at least 40 <Term:1000024></Term> and after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> and consume 30 Purr Energy to activate:
Nekomata enters Vital View and swiftly moves behind the enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. This skill does not consume dodge uses.

102100011.Title: Dash Attack: Over Here!
102100011.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

102100012.Title: Dodge Counter: Phantom Claws
102100012.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

102100013.Title: Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw
102100013.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Disappearing Tail</color>, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> with at least 40 <Term:1000024></Term> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

102100014.Title: Chain Attack: Claw Swipe
102100014.Description:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

102100015.Title: Ultimate: Claw Smash
102100015.Description:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

102100018.Title: Quick Assist: Cat's Paw
102100018.Description:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

102100019.Title: Defensive Assist: Desperate Defense
102100019.Description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

102100020.Title: Assist Follow-Up: Shadow Strike
102100020.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
